content: Makumawetsie nuiwarite kememɨtekuyaxixɨ
Merikɨtsɨ Yawé Muitsexi 'Aruni mame mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe:
«'Ixaheritsixi 'ixuriki tukiyari manuwe memayutixexeɨriwa 'aurie mekanayaxetɨkɨnikuni yupatera mehexeiyatɨ meta yu'inɨari, hepana meheutanenieretɨ, yuxexuitɨ kememɨyupapaɨme nuiwarite.
»Tau manatineika 'aurie, mana mekanitiyaxikuni kemɨ'ane Kura memaweiya, kememɨyupapaɨme. Nahatsuni wa'ukiyari kanihɨkɨtɨni 'Aminarawi nu'aya.
Yunaitɨ haika tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana nauka miriyari heimana 'ataxewime tsienituyari (74.600) 'ukitsi mekaniyupaɨmeni.
»Kura memakutei wa'aurie 'Itsakaxi xiɨyarimama mekanitiyaxikuni. Natanaheri wa'ukiyari kanihɨkɨtɨni Tsuhaxi nu'aya.
Yunaitɨ huta tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana nauka miriyari heimana nauka tsienituyari (54.400) 'ukitsi mekaniyupaɨmeni.
»Tapa pɨtata Tsawuruni xiɨyarimama mekanikuyaxikuni. 'Eriyáwi wa'ukiyari kanihɨkɨtɨni Heruni nu'aya.
Yunaitɨ huta tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'atahuta miriyari heimana nauka tsienituyari (57.400) 'ukitsi mekaniyupaɨmeni.
»Yunaitɨ Kura xiɨyarimama mekaniyupaɨmeni, xeitsienituyari heimana nauka tewiyari heimana 'ataxewi miriyari heimana nauka tsienituyari (186.400), mɨkɨ mekananuyeyaxikuni.
»Tatsutɨata Xuweni memaweiya yunaitɨ kememuyupaɨme yupatera hetɨa mana mekanitiyaxikuni, 'ikɨ yameyupaɨmetɨ. 'Eritsuxi wa'ukiyari kanihɨkɨtɨni Tserehuxi nu'aya.
Yunaitɨ kuyaximama huta tewiyari heimana 'ataxewi miriyari heimana 'auxɨwime tsienituyari (46.500) 'ukitsi mekaniyupaɨmeni.
»Xuweni wa'aurie Tsimehuni xiɨyarimama mekanitiyaxikuni. Tserumieri wa'ukiyari katinitewaka Tsuritsarahi nu'aya.
Yunaitɨ huta tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'atanauka miriyari heimana haika tsienituyari (59.300) 'ukitsi mekaniyupaɨmeni.
»Wa'aurieta mekanitiyaxikuni Kahari xiɨyarimama. 'Eriyatsati wa'ukiyari kanihɨkɨtɨni Xehueri nu'aya.
Yunaitɨ huta tewiyari heimana 'auxɨwi miriyari heimana 'ataxewi tsienituyari heimana huta tewiyari heimana tamamata (45.650) 'ukitsi mekaniyupaɨmeni.

»Yunaitɨ Xuweni xiɨyarimama memakutei, me'inɨaritɨ kememuyupaɨme wanuiwarite, xeitsienituyari heimana huta tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana xewi miriyari heimana nauka tsienituyari heimana huta tewiyari heimana tamamata (151.450) 'ukitsi memuyupaɨme, mɨkɨ hutariekatsie memɨyehu.
»Merikɨte 'ixuriki tukiyari me'akwetɨ rewitsixi mekaniyekɨkakaɨtɨni yunaime wahixɨapa memukutei. Yaxeikɨa mekateniyaxikuni kehepaɨ memɨteheukutekai yuxexuitɨ yuhuyeripa meta yupatera me'akwetɨ.
»Tau makayuyuipiketsie yupatera hetɨa mekanitiyaxikuni 'Epɨrahini xiɨyarimama, kehepaɨ memɨteheukununuiwa. 'Eritsama wa'ukiyari kanihɨkɨtɨni 'Amihuri nu'aya.
Kuyaximama nauka tewiyari miriyari heimana 'auxɨwime tsienituyari (40.500) 'ukitsi memuyupaɨme.
»'Epɨrahini 'aurieta mekanitiyaxikuni Manatsexi xiɨyarimama. Kamarieri wa'ukiyari kanihɨkɨtɨni Peratsuxi nu'aya.
Kuyaximama xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana huta miriyari heimana huta tsienituyari (32.200) 'ukitsi mekaniyupaɨmeni.
»Xaɨtsieta mekanitiyaxikuni Wenikamini xiɨyarimama. 'Awirani wa'ukiyari mɨhɨkɨ Kerehuni nu'aya.
Yunaitɨ xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'auxɨwi miriyari heimama nauka tsienituyari (35.400) 'ukitsi mekaniyupaɨmeni.

»Yunaitɨ kuyakɨ memɨyɨwawe 'Epɨrahini 'aurie memukutei, yunaitɨ me'inɨaritɨ yameyupapaɨmetɨ, xeitsienituyari heimana 'atahaika miriyari heimana xeitsienituyari (108.100) 'ukitsi, mɨkɨ mekaniyehuni hairiekatsie.
»Tayeta mekanitiyaxikuni Rani xiɨyarimama, kememɨyupaɨme. 'Akihetsexi wa'ukiyari kanihɨkɨtɨni 'Amitsarahi nu'aya.
Mekaniyupaɨmeni yunaitɨ haika tewiyari heimana huta miriyari heimana 'atahuta tsienituyari (62.700) 'ukitsi.
»Rani 'aurieta 'Atsexi xiɨyarimama mekanitiyaxikuni. Pakieri wa'ukiyari mɨhɨkɨ 'Ukɨrani nu'aya.
Yunaitɨ huta tewiyari heimana xewi miriyari heimana 'auxɨwi tsienituyari (41.500) 'ukitsi memɨhɨkɨ.
»Wa'auriepaita mekanikuyaxikuni Nepɨtahari xiɨyarimama. Wa'ukiyari pɨhɨkɨ 'Akira 'Enahani nu'aya.
Yunaitɨ mekaniyupaɨmeni huta tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana haika miriyari heimana nauka tsienituyari (53.400) 'ukitsi.

»Yunaitɨ memuta'inierie kuyaxi Rani 'aurie mekanikuyaxe, yunaitɨ xeitsienituyari heimana huta tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'atahuta miriyari heimana 'ataxewime tsienituyari (157.600) 'ukitsi mekaniyutipaɨmere, mɨkɨ wa'utɨmake mekanayekɨnikuni yupatera me'akwetɨ».

Merikɨte 'ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni 'ixaheritsixi waniwema memaka'utɨarie kuyaxikɨ memɨyɨwawe kememɨyupapaɨmekai. Yunaitɨ Kuyaxi memuta'inierie yuxexuitɨ 'ataxewi tsienituyari heimana haika miriyari heimana 'auxɨwi tsienituyari heimana huta tewiyari heimana tamamata (603.550) 'ukitsi mekaniyutipaɨmere.
Peru Rewitsixi hipame 'ixaheritsixi wamahatɨa mepɨka'utinɨitɨarie, Yawé Muitsexi kemutiuta'aitɨakai yapɨtiuyɨ.

Hikɨ 'ixaheritsixi Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ kemɨtiutahɨawekai yamekatenikakɨne: kememɨyupapaɨmekai 'axeikɨa mekanikuyaxikekaitɨni yupatera mehexeiyatɨkaitɨ meta memayekɨkakaitsie kememɨte'ununuiwaxɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenayekɨkakaitɨni 'iwamarixi xeinuiwaritetsie miemete.
